resources.string: Sign in to your Krunk account and sync bookmarks, history, settings, open tabs and passwords with your other devices
Sign in to the Krunk account you use on Windows. Your data is encrypted on this device before it leaves; the server can\'t read it. Nothing is sent until you sign in.
Approve this device on krunk.kruxsys.com: open the page below (or go to krunk.kruxsys.com/link on another device), sign in there and check this code:
Bookmarks, history, settings, new tab pins, ad-blocker exceptions, open tabs and, with your passwords unlocked, passwords. Phone-only settings (toolbar position, text size) stay on this device.
Sign out of your Krunk account?
This device\'s sync keys and sign-in are deleted. Your bookmarks, history and passwords stay on this device unless you also remove what came from sync.
Sign out and remove synced data
Your sync passphrase and recovery key

This is the first device of your account to sync. Write these down and keep them safe and private: with either one you can restore your synced data on a new device. The Krunk website never asks for them.
Last group of the recovery key (4 characters before the last dash)
I saved them: turn on sync
Your account already syncs on another device. Get the keys from it, or restore with your sync passphrase or recovery key.
These devices keep access to your sync data
Open krunk://sync on your Windows device and approve this one. It then shows 6 digits.
The 6 digits the other device shows
No open tabs from other devices yet.
To bring your passwords along, create or unlock your password vault first (Passwords), then come back. Without it, everything else syncs and you can add passwords later.
Passwords sync while your password vault is unlocked.
Passwords: unlock your password vault to sync them.
Passwords don\'t sync on this phone yet: it has no password vault. Create one in Passwords, then come back here to add your passwords.
Passwords don\'t sync on this phone yet. Type your vault password (the one on your PC) to bring them.
Waiting for your PC… Open Krunk on the PC, go to Settings › Account & sync, and approve this phone (its passwords vault must be unlocked).
Type the 6 digits your PC shows
Code sent. The passwords key is on its way…
Or, without the PC: your sync passphrase (7 words, shown once when sync was first turned on) or recovery key (KRNK-…). Not your vault password.
Checking… this takes a few seconds.
Turn on sync with your vault password

Your vault password (the one that unlocks your saved passwords) also protects your synced data. On your other devices you sign in and type this same password. If this phone has no password vault yet, this makes one with it.
Type your vault password: the one you unlock your passwords with on your PC. Your bookmarks, history, tabs, settings and passwords then come to this phone.
This phone\'s password vault has a different password. Sync goes on; to bring your passwords, open the vault with your PC\'s vault password.
The vault password needs at least %1$d characters.
